openFrame: Every boundary D-002 ships, including but not limited to the families below. A D-002 successor that adds a boundary adds an owed row here; silence is not coverage.
authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES the scoped preview threat model D-030 authorized the coordinator to draft. whatMayBeDesigned: Architecture-preview analyze and doctor, CLI-first, offline default, first-party/explicitly-trusted components, local non-authoritative state, four named platforms. Not a security-complete product. Not OpenSIP MVP. Not an authoritative sealed gate.

threatsTreated: Unexpected flags or subcommands are not a grant of a consented act.
Non-interactive CI must not prompt (file 03 / doctor v4).
previewMitigations: Closed command set. Unknown command is a usage failure, not a probe or egress.
Doctor default remains read-only, no component code, no network.
boundaries.mustNotClaim: A command name is not named consent for CA-1..CA-4.
boundaries.fullTmStillOwes: Complete command-surface abuse cases, including future commands D-002 does not ship.

threatsTreated: A repository the operator named can contain hostile source, crafted configs, and unexpected encodings.
Parser/provider admission is a trust boundary (D-030).
previewMitigations: Analyze treats project bytes as untrusted input. Doctor default reads are host-owned or project-bounded; out-of-root reads are CA-3 and unexercisable until product admission and the host-effect contract.
No ambient Node. TypeScript closure is exact-byte (DR-119 product rule; row still OPEN).
boundaries.mustNotClaim: Preview does not claim a sandbox. A child process is fault containment (file 02), not a sandbox.
boundaries.fullTmStillOwes: Parser-admission threat catalog, encoding/alias attacks, and the FACT-PLANE subject-set agreement (DR-006 / DR-011-R01).

threatsTreated: A spawned component's subsequent effects are its own (D-032 / doctor v4 consentDoesNotCascade).
In-process TypeScript shares address space; confinement is disclosure-only there (permission v1 in-host mode).
previewMitigations: Component tails ride DR-105. Host spawn decision rides the host-effect contract and DR-G21.
Networked-posture spawn without separate host CA-4 is refused.
DR-128 excludes third-party/untrusted from MVP; preview inherits that exclusion.
boundaries.mustNotClaim: Trusted first-party is not enforced confinement. DISCLOSURE-ONLY cells stay disclosure-only.
boundaries.fullTmStillOwes: Permission-truth-tables successor (v1 REJECT, 3 blockers), race tests, and any future in-process vs child-process product choice.

threatsTreated: Local state can be deleted, forged by a same-user TCB member, or mistaken for sealed assurance.
previewMitigations: Authoritative sealed closure, replay, and evidence custody are OUT of the preview (D-002).
Preview design must label local state non-authoritative. It must not be a grant journal.
boundaries.mustNotClaim: Rebuildable state is not V10/custody and is not G19.
boundaries.fullTmStillOwes: Durable monotonic ordering, sealed custody, G19 negative controls, clock/entropy as undeclared Plan inputs (DR-124 / DR-G19).

previewAssets: SARIF 2.1.0 advertised for analyze only, riding DR-006
threatsTreated: Output that claims an authoritative gate the preview cannot produce.
Serialization failure on a user-named path (DR-G17).
previewMitigations: D-018 forbids describing the preview as an authoritative sealed gate, OpenSIP MVP, or upgrade continuity.
SARIF drops if DR-006 closes by scoped disposition rather than binding recipes (D-002 identity-dependencies).
boundaries.mustNotClaim: A verdict and a D9 exit are not a durable authoritative record of having gated.
boundaries.fullTmStillOwes: Post-commit output failure preserving a sealed Run (out of preview). Redaction corpus execution (DR-114 fixture half).

previewMitigations: No Windows grant path in the host-effect contract.
Per-platform truth tables remain DR-105's and are not closed (permission v1 REJECT).
boundaries.mustNotClaim: Four-platform matrix completeness. Narrowing platforms requires a D-002 successor (D-018).
boundaries.fullTmStillOwes: The four-platform enforcement matrix, Windows disposition, and any notarization/signing differences.

threatsTreated: Substituted, unsigned, expired, revoked, rollbacked, or wrong-platform root/index/core/component bytes at first install.

Doctor is a host surface under instruction (D-032). Its default is no network. Consented host acts are unexercisable until the host-effect contract has a live owner-recorded instance (FC-C1). D-038 recorded the accepted design contract; that is not FC-C1.
Node closure must be exact-byte and offline (DR-119). Ambient Node is not a runtime.
previewMitigations: First-install trust and signed delivery refuse unverified or wrong-platform bytes on the scoped DR-G08 surfaces (root/index/core/component install trust).
G08 scoped; repair-media/rollback defer with DR-110. Upgrade continuity remains forbidden by D-018 / DR-130.
Doctor KEYCHAIN unexercisable (DR-108 deferred). Self-update/repair deferred (DR-110).
boundaries.mustNotClaim: Install trust is not upgrade continuity (DR-130). Doctor consent is not a DR-105 grant.
boundaries.fullTmStillOwes: Publication block, V10/custody demonstration, air-gap/update recovery, and third-party publishing (post-MVP).
